title: RWA Weekly Report With Token Terminal: Stablecoins, Funds and Stocks
description: Weekly market cap and holder growth by issuer and chain across stablecoins, funds and stocks.

blocks.text: This is the weekly edition of RWA Activity on the Terminal, a joint report from RWA Foundation and Token Terminal. It covers stablecoins, tokenized funds and tokenized stocks over the past 7 days, by issuer and by chain, for both market cap and holders.

parts.text: This is the weekly edition of RWA Activity on the Terminal, a joint report from RWA Foundation and Token Terminal. It covers stablecoins, tokenized funds and tokenized stocks over the past 7 days, by issuer and by chain, for both market cap and holders.

blocks.text: All figures are taken strictly from Token Terminal as of October 8, 2026. Growth figures cover the 7-day window from October 1 to October 8. No third-party data has been added, and no figures have been adjusted or estimated.

blocks.text: Market cap refers to circulating asset market cap as reported by Token Terminal. Holders refers to addresses holding a non-zero balance, summed across assets without removing duplicates. blocks.text: Overview

parts.text: Overview

blocks.text: Across the top 10 issuers, stablecoins added $1.77 billion in market cap over the week, tokenized funds $636.5 million and tokenized stocks $209.6 million. Falcon Finance led stablecoins, Sky led tokenized funds and Binance bStocks led tokenized stocks.

blocks.text: Holder growth followed a different path. The top 10 stablecoin issuers added 2.31 million holder addresses, tokenized stock issuers 254,600 and tokenized fund issuers 1,443.

parts.text: Stablecoins

blocks.text: Conclusion

parts.text: Conclusion

blocks.text: Stablecoins accounted for most of the week's growth, led by Falcon Finance, Tether and Open Standard by issuer and by Ethereum and Solana by chain. Tokenized funds grew mainly through Sky and J.P. Morgan, on Ethereum and Stellar. Tokenized stocks were led by Binance bStocks and xStocks, on BNB Chain and X Layer.

parts.text: Stablecoins accounted for most of the week's growth, led by Falcon Finance, Tether and Open Standard by issuer and by Ethereum and Solana by chain. Tokenized funds grew mainly through Sky and J.P. Morgan, on Ethereum and Stellar. Tokenized stocks were led by Binance bStocks and xStocks, on BNB Chain and X Layer.

blocks.text: As in earlier editions, the chains and issuers adding the most market cap were often not the ones adding the most holders. Ethereum led stablecoin and fund market cap growth but ranked lower by holders, while BNB Chain, Arbitrum One and Solana led holder growth in their sectors.
